# Definition
**Preterm Prelabor Rupture of Membranes** (PPROM) is rupture of membranes that occurs at <37 weeks gestation and prior to the onset of labor. 

# Management 
- latency antibiotic ppx - prevent fulminant intraamniotic infection 
- corticosteroids - decrease risk of neonatal RDS. 
- fetal surveillance 

with delivery at 34 weeks 

# Complications 
## Chorioamnionitis 
If a fetus comes into contact with ascending vaginal and/or enteric tissue, it may become infected. 

### Pt 
- maternal fever, 
- maternal leukocytosis, 
- fetal tachycardia > 160, 
- purulent amniotic fluid

### Tx 
- delivery regardless of gestational age
